responsibility: Implements reusable RTL expansion helpers for the x86 backend. This file contains target-side expansion routines for splitting wide values into halves, reconstructing doubleword results, vector and reduction support helpers, atomic compare-exchange and fetch-op retry loops, divmod libcall expansion, special conversions such as fast BF16-to-SF extension, and other code-generation utilities that are shared by patterns and hooks but are more focused than the monolithic logic in i386.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-expand.h, which only publishes helper types and prototypes, this file contains the actual reusable RTL expansion code for x86, such as doubleword splitting/concatenation, atomic cmpxchg loops, divmod libcall expansion, and BF16 conversion helpers.
